founders.title: Built in Delhi. Now on North American retail floors.
story: Shikha Gupta and Aditya Gupta founded Thridify in Delhi in 2022, convinced that flat product photos were quietly costing brands sales — and that most teams had no realistic way to fix it.
Today Shikha (Co-Founder & CEO) leads the company from the Greater Toronto Area, bringing 3D and AR commerce to North American retailers and the suppliers behind them.
Aditya (Co-Founder & CTO) and the Delhi team power the rest — the engineering, 3D production and operations that turn a single SKU into something a customer can explore.

mission.title: Make every product touchable, configurable and real — before the sale.
mission.body: The next decade of commerce belongs to brands that let customers experience products with showroom depth — from anywhere. Thridify puts that within reach of any team: real-time 3D, app-free AR, expert 3D modelling and analytics — no code required.
